body.name: I_j^{\alpha}
body.construction:
For \(j\in\mathcal J\), let
\[
Q_j^\alpha=\{q_j(\mathcal M):p'\in\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}(\widehat p),\ (G,\mathcal M)\in\mathfrak F(\mathcal S,L,H,p')\}.
\]
Define \(I_j^\alpha=\varnothing\) if \(Q_j^\alpha=\varnothing\), and otherwise define
\[
I_j^\alpha=[\min Q_j^\alpha,\max Q_j^\alpha].
\]
The extrema range jointly over the confidence fiber; incompatible values of \(p'\) contribute no feasible point, and the empty-confidence-fiber output is explicitly represented.
